violations.text: Food contact surfaces of ice machine were observed with an accumulation of black residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off, and staff began melting/disposing of ice at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

The floor behind the ice machine was observed to have an accumulation of soil/debris. Physical facilities are to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/10/2026

The wall behind the ice machine was observed to have damage (drywall was cracked/chipped) and in need of repair. Physical facilities are to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2027

At the time of inspection, the back counter mini fridge was observed to be maintaining an ambient temperature of 43 degrees Fahrenheit with ice formed on the inside of the unit blocking air flow. Per the PIC, unit is to be defrosted and checked for proper cold holding ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below prior to use. New Violation. Correct By: 11/20/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Ice machine is to be cleaned at a frequency to keep it clean and to preclude the buildup of residue and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 11/20/2025
